history.summary: Identity uncertain/provisional - very thin web footprint. The Ichadevi Temple appears as a religious spot in Burhanpur in the official Burhanpur District Disaster Management Plan (listed as 'Ichadevi Mandir', ~60-70 visitors/day during peak season/festivals) and in a Burhanpur tour-itinerary blog; a YouTube video title references an 'Ichadevi mandir' at Ichapur, Madhya Pradesh (Ichapur is a village near Burhanpur), but no dedicated article, history, or images of this temple were found. Coordinates below are town-level for Burhanpur (uncertain). Do NOT confuse with the Ichadevi Mandir mapped at Jalgaon, Maharashtra on OpenStreetMap/Mapcarta - that is a different temple. CSV state-column error: the source CSV lists the town in the 'state' column - the site is in Madhya Pradesh.
